priorityList: Delay Combustion and do not cast Flamestrike if the target is above 90% health when talented into Firestarter.
Cast Combustion when ready, timing the activation to occur near the end of a hard-cast Frostfire Bolt.
Cast Meteor immediately as it becomes available, unless it has been delayed more than 10 seconds, in which case save it for Combustion.
During Combustion, cast Meteor so that it lands before the buff expires (ideally when 2 to 8 seconds remain).
On 4 or more targets, cast Flamestrike when you have Hot Streak.
Hardcast Flamestrike (on 4+ targets) or Pyroblast (on 1-3 targets) when Pyroclasm procs.
Cast Scorch if Heat Shimmer is active and you do not have a Hot Streak.
Cast Fire Blast to convert Heating Up into Hot Streak.
Use Frostfire Bolt as your primary filler to generate Heating Up and Hot Streak.
Use Scorch as a filler only when moving and unable to cast Frostfire Bolt.
Cast Combustion when entering combat with a large pack of enemies.
Cast Meteor on the target cluster to deal high burst damage and trigger Isothermic Core.
Cast Flamestrike whenever Hot Streak is active.
Cast Phoenix Flames to spread Ignite to secondary targets or when Excess Fire is active.
Cast Fire Blast to convert Heating Up into Hot Streak procs or to trigger Excess Frost cleave.
Cast Dragon's Breath to consume Lit Fuse procs and trigger Living Bomb on targets.
Cast Shifting Power to recover ability charges, provided Combustion is on cooldown.
Cast Frostfire Bolt as your primary filler to generate Heating Up and maintain Frostfire Empowerment stacks.
